title: Unauthenticated Public Demo Tokens Endpoint Enabled by Default
description: The configuration property zkdoc.demo.seed-enabled defaults to true (${ZKDOC_DEMO_SEED_ENABLED:true}). When active, DemoTokensController exposes GET /api/public/demo-tokens without authentication, dispensing valid RSA-2048-signed Bearer JWT tokens for all roles including ADMIN.
impact: If deployed to production without explicitly overriding ZKDOC_DEMO_SEED_ENABLED=false, an anonymous remote attacker can obtain full administrative access to key management and audit operations.
recommendation: Invert the configuration default to false in application.yml (${ZKDOC_DEMO_SEED_ENABLED:false}) and require explicit opt-in for demo environments.

title: Default Static Database Credentials in Docker Compose Manifest
description: docker-compose.yml specifies fallback default credentials POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-zkdoc_local_dev_secret} across postgres, api, and backup container definitions.
impact: Deploying the containerized application without an explicit .env file causes PostgreSQL to boot with a known, hardcoded secret, allowing network-adjacent attackers to connect directly to the database.
recommendation: Remove fallback default password literals from docker-compose.yml. Enforce mandatory environment variable injection and validate non-empty secret values in pre-flight scripts.

title: Document Artifact Storage Filesystem Payloads Unencrypted at Rest
description: FilesystemDocumentArtifactStorage writes uploaded document bytes directly to disk in plaintext. While path traversal defense, atomic replacement, and SHA-256 integrity verification are enforced, confidentiality at rest is omitted.
impact: If an attacker achieves local filesystem read access, volume backup leakage, or host compromise, confidential stored document files can be exfiltrated in plaintext.
recommendation: Implement an envelope encryption stream decorator (AES-256-GCM) with an external KMS or environment-provided master key before writing artifact bytes to disk.

title: Startup In-Process Asymmetric Key Generation and Non-HSM Private Key Storage
description: For local development and evaluation convenience, asymmetric signing keys are generated in-process on startup if unconfigured. The key registry stores public key metadata and points to environment file paths for private keys, lacking hardware-backed protection (HSM/KMS).
impact: Keys do not persist across process restarts in default dev mode unless configured, and private key files on disk are vulnerable to host-level exfiltration.
recommendation: Integrate an enterprise Key Management Service (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, or HashiCorp Vault) or PKCS#11 HSM provider for production signing operations.

title: PostgreSQL Flyway Integration Test Skipped on Hosts Without Active Docker Daemon
description: PostgresFlywayMigrationIntegrationTest uses Testcontainers with @EnabledIf("isDockerAvailable"). When executed locally on hosts where Docker Desktop is inactive, the test is skipped (1 skipped test). PostgreSQL migrations (V1-V8) are only verified in CI.
impact: Developers without a running local Docker engine cannot verify PostgreSQL migration consistency prior to pushing commits.
recommendation: Provide an optional embedded/in-memory PostgreSQL profile or a remote test database flag to allow running PostgreSQL migration tests when Docker Desktop is offline.

title: In-Memory Rate Limiting Storage Does Not Enforce Clustered Multi-Node Limits
description: BucketRateLimitService uses an in-memory ConcurrentHashMap backed by Bucket4j token buckets. In a horizontally scaled cluster, each node enforces limits independently.
impact: Effective public verification rate limit multiplies by the number of active container replicas, increasing DoS vulnerability on public endpoints.
recommendation: Implement a distributed Redis/Lettuce backing store for Bucket4j in production profiles.

title: Zero-Knowledge Predicate Scope Strictly Limited to Range Inequalities
description: The platform's zero-knowledge capability is specifically Bulletproof range proofs for attribute >= threshold predicates over Ristretto255 Pedersen commitments. It does not provide general arithmetic circuits or ZK-SNARK protocols.
impact: Potential misalignment of expectations if stakeholders assume arbitrary zero-knowledge computation or universal selective disclosure.
recommendation: Maintain explicit documentation regarding implemented range predicate scope across API references and academic viva presentation materials.

title: Relaxed Content Security Policy Allows Inline Styles ('unsafe-inline')
description: The Content-Security-Policy header permits style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' to accommodate runtime CSS utilities.
impact: Allows attackers who manage to inject style elements to alter layout or conduct CSS-based exfiltration/defacement.
recommendation: Transition to nonce-based or hash-based CSP directives for style elements and precompile all styling.
